title: lagenocarpus alboniger

This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Lagenocarpus alboniger are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to ease congestion and promote the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
